# `lakana raw`

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_reference.py from the Typer app. Do not edit by hand:
run `uv run python scripts/generate_reference.py` and commit the result. -->

Part of the [Command line reference](../cli.md), which lists the options for every command.

Usage: `lakana raw [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...`

Look under raw/, where the files of external tables lie.

## `lakana raw ls`

Usage: `lakana raw ls [OPTIONS] [path]`

List folder PATH of raw/, one page at a time: its folders and files with their sizes.

A folder or file inside an external table's folder names the table (when you may read it): it cannot be used for another table. Needs CREATE_TABLE on a namespace of the environment. Register a table over a folder with `lakana table create-external`.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PATH` | text | `raw` | The folder: raw, or a folder below it, such as raw/orders. |
| `--env` | text | none | Environment (default: the profile's). |
| `--limit` | whole number, 1 to 200 | none | Most rows to list (default 100). |
| `--cursor` | text | none | Continue after the page that printed this cursor. |
